voix.style: Warm, natural French male narrator with a Parisian accent, talking to one person like a friend who knows lighting, never flat, never robotic, one steady pace from the first word to the last with no rushing. The tone follows the moment: the opening line punchy and a little provocative, a playful challenge; the three rules clear and explanatory, like showing someone how to measure with a tape measure; a small spark of surprise on each result (soixante-douze, quatre-vingt-dix, soixante, quarante-cinq, trente-cinq); the very last line rising and suspended, left unfinished, as if the sentence goes on.
